messages:
Priya Nair: FYI customer (AcmePayments) reporting a sudden spike of 502/503s starting ~02:00 UTC, looks correlated with our scheduled token rotation. They see consistent 502s for /v1/generate when using long-lived SDK clients. Logs show gateway 502 but backend model instances are healthy. This thread for troubleshooting and comms.

Marta Lopez: thanks, digging in. Do we have LB/gateway logs for that timeframe? any 503/504 from our edge? Also which SDK version? customer said they hadn't updated recently.

Priya Nair: SDK v1.4.2, Node. They attached curl reproducer that hits streaming endpoint and gets 502 after ~3s of tokens being rotated. Edge logs excerpt below:

infra-bot: [AUTOMATED LOG] 2026-03-10T02:01:15Z gateway error client_ip=203.0.113.12 path=/v1/generate status=502 backend_status=0 reason="upstream prematurely closed" conn_id=abcd1234

Alex Kim: hmm "upstream prematurely closed" often means pooled connections were reused after auth rotated and backend rejected the request. Could be our gateway reusing http/2 conn with old bearer token cached at the backend proxy. Any recent change to token TTL or rotation mechanism?

Marta Lopez: We pushed a zero-downtime token rotation last week that updates service account creds and updates routing metadata. It was tested but maybe we didn't flush keepalive pools. I'll check gateway conn pool code.

SRE Oncall: timeline — 02:00 rotator job kicked off, rotated service-account tokens (TTL decreased to 10m temporarily). Immediately after we see ~120 502s over 5m window. Backend model pods show no crash, CPU steady, request traces missing X-Request-ID for many failed attempts.

Priya Nair: Customer repro steps (from them):
1) Start long-running Node process with Redwood SDK, keep a single client instance.
2) Send continuous generate requests every 1s for 10m.
3) At rotation time they get 502s for ~2-4 minutes, then it recovers.

Alex Kim: probable cause: SDK keeps Authorization header per connection; when token rotates, new requests on existing connection still present old token until connection rebinds. Gateway forwards, backend rejects -> gateway translates to 502. Two mitigations: force SDK to refresh connection when token changes OR have gateway validate tokens per-request rather than relying on pooled TLS session metadata.

Marta Lopez: quick repro on internal env — I ran their script against a staging gateway with a forced token rotate. Reproduced 502s. Stack trace in gateway: 
```
httpproxy/pool.go: line 214: reuseConnLocked -> conn.authorization = cachedAuth
httpproxy/proxy.go: line 89: forwardRequest -> read response failed: EOF
```

SRE Oncall: immediate short-term mitigation: rolling restart of gateway workers to flush connection pools. Doing that now in staging, then prod if it fixes.

infra-bot: [ACTION] rolling restart of gateway workers in us-east-1 initiated by SRE Oncall at 02:12 UTC

Marta Lopez: Restarted 3/3 gateway workers in staging, 0 502s post-restart during another rotation test. Looks promising.

Priya Nair: Jenna (CS) can you draft a note to AcmePayments: A brief apology, we identified token rotation + connection pooling mismatch as root cause, immediate mitigation applied (gateway worker restarts), and a permanent fix ETA.

Jenna (CS): Drafted message, posting here for review:
> Hi team — we’re sorry for the degraded experience last night. We identified the issue as our token rotation interacting with persistent connections causing temporary 5xx failures. We’ve applied a mitigation and will deploy a permanent fix by EOD tomorrow. If you prefer, we can schedule a dedicated window to coordinate rotations so your clients don’t hit the window. Thanks for the report and patience. — Jenna

Alex Kim: tiny wording nit: replace "last night" with timestamp 02:00 UTC and add "no data loss". Also offer a workaround: restart the SDK client on rotation or upgrade to v1.5.0 which will detect token rotation and re-establish connections automatically.

Jenna (CS): updated draft and sent to the customer. They replied appreciating transparency and asked for timeline for permanent fix.

Marta Lopez: permanent fix options:
- Option A (preferred): gateway change to re-validate Authorization header per-request, avoid relying on pooled metadata. Requires kernel-level socket handling change and ~4-5 day rollout with canaries.
- Option B: on token rotation, emit a signal to gateways to drain connection pools for affected service-account (faster, ~24h cadence to implement, less invasive).

Alex Kim: I vote Option B as fast remediation, then follow with A for long-term robustness.

SRE Oncall: Plan: implement Option B, add automated drain hook in rotator; meanwhile, schedule a controlled gateway worker restart for the customer's org during their next rotation window if they want it now. I'll file infra ticket INFRA-4227 and assign to Marta.

infra-bot: [TICKET CREATED] INFRA-4227 - connection-pool-drain-on-credential-rotation assigned to Marta Lopez, priority P1

Priya Nair: Thanks all. Follow-ups: Marta, estimate for B? Jenna, keep customer updated with INFRA-4227 link and ETA. Alex, prepare SDK changelog blurb for v1.5.0 recommending auto-reconnect on token refresh.

Marta Lopez: ETA for Option B implementation and safety tests: ~18-24 hours. Will post progress to this thread.

SRE Oncall: marking this incident as major-minor, postmortem draft requested after resolution. Will update on prod rollout start.

Priya Nair: closing loop for now — I'll add an incident banner to status.redwood.ai noting a brief auth rotation-related degraded performance at 02:00 UTC affecting a subset of long-lived SDK clients. :alert:

Alex Kim: also logging a unit test to simulate token rotate + pooled connection in our integration harness.

Jenna (CS): Customer confirmed they can tolerate mitigation and asked to be CC'd on INFRA-4227. I added them. They also asked if rotating tokens could be coordinated per-customer — noted.

Marta Lopez: 02:45 UTC update: PR open with drain hook and operator job to call /admin/drain-connections for affected SA. CI passing, safety-run scheduled.

infra-bot: [AUTOMATED NOTE] 2026-03-10T02:46:00Z PR#5423 opened by mlopez - implements connection-pool-drain-on-rotation

Priya Nair: thanks, keep thread updated. If anyone sees recurring 5xx after the drain deployment, tag SRE Oncall immediately.
